messages:
Sam: starting a tiny canary for v3p0-int4 on shortanswers + longdoc seeds, want consensus on auto-fallback thresholds before we ramp to 15%
Priya: sounds good. what's the initial split?
Sam: 3% longdoc, 3% shortanswers -> plan to jump to 15% after stable 20m window
Leo: propose triggers: abs MRR drop > 1.8% OR structured hallucination rate increase > 0.7pp OR token-level entropy increase > 0.5
Priya: add p99 latency increase > 25% as a hard stop. also set a soft alert if MRR drop > 0.9% so PM/infra can look before rollback
Sam: draft config (feel free to tweak):
```
monitor_window_mins: 20
mrr_relative_drop_pct: 1.8
soft_alert_mrr_pct: 0.9
structured_halluc_pp: 0.7
p99_latency_increase_pct: 25
min_aggregated_samples: 3000
entropy_increase_bits: 0.5
```
Priya: min samples 3k ok for 3% seed? might take a while. maybe allow aggregated cross-slice counting
Leo: agree to aggregated. also enable kv-warmup=true and seed with a handful of high-risk prompts from last regression
Sam: ops-bot kicked off canary at 1723579040 :rocket:
ops-bot: Canary deployed: v3p0-int4 @ 3% (longdoc/shortanswers), watching MRR, structured_halluc, p99_latency, token_entropy
Priya: 10m in — quick smoke: MRR +0.2%, halluc -0.01pp, p99 +3%
Leo: tagging EvalRunner to run fast 1k prompt pass on the high-risk set: @EvalRunner
EvalRunner: ran 1k rerun on high-risk slice: observed structured halluc +0.6pp (from 0.4% -> 1.0%), formatting oddities increased, not super widespread
Sam: we need to hit 3k aggregated samples before auto rules apply. aggregation ETA ~6m
Priya: aggregated samples reached 3k at 1723579145: MRR -1.2%, structured_halluc +0.65pp, p99 +4%, entropy +0.05 bits
Leo: threshold crossing? MRR not over 1.8 but halluc almost 0.7pp. we said >0.7pp. it's 0.65 so just under. no auto-fallback yet but soft alert threshold hit (0.9% was for MRR, not met)
Sam: open a transient alert for triage. Priya to confirm manual check on longdoc formatting examples
Priya: manual pass: found a sub-slice of 120 examples with repeated hallucinated citations — concerning but small. will add to ticket
EvalRunner: running a secondary 2k longdoc-only pass to see if structured halluc expands
ops-bot: Canary still running at 3% — no auto-fallback triggered (current deltas: mrr=-1.2, hall=+0.65pp, p99=+4)
EvalRunner: secondary longdoc 2k done: additional 80 bad examples, aggregated halluc up to +0.72pp across longdoc slice (now total aggregated hall +0.68pp overall)
Leo: now we're crossing the hallucination trigger on longdoc slice but overall agg is marginal. we need rule clarity: do we auto-fallback on slice-level exceed or only global aggregate?
Sam: good point. current rule was global aggregate. proposal: allow immediate fallback if any seeded slice exceeds hallucination delta > 0.7pp AND that slice has >=500 samples
Priya: +1. that would have caught the longdoc bump early and avoided more exposure
Sam: updating rule and executing auto-fallback at 1723579175 per new slice-level clause
ops-bot: Auto-fallback executed: reverted to baseline at 1723579175. Reason: longdoc slice hallucination_delta_pp=+0.72 (slice samples=520)
Leo: filing issue with diffs and token logits, S3 dump: s3://redwood-canary-artifacts/1723579012-v3p0-int4-dump.json
Priya: next steps: 1) small calibration pass (no retrain) + repack with adjust kv-warmup tuning, 2) shrink initial canary to 2% and extend monitor_window to 30m, 3) add slice-level strictness to canary rules
Sam: thanks all — will schedule a reattempt after calibration. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
